title: Archax Adds Chainlink Pricing to Tokenized Treasury Product
why_it_matters: Reliable machine-readable pricing is a necessary infrastructure layer before tokenized Treasury exposure can be assessed and managed inside automated credit and collateral systems.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONAL TOKENIZATION

Archax Adds Chainlink Pricing to Tokenized Treasury Product

Archax integrated Chainlink Data Streams with $GOVY, its auto-rolling tokenized U.S. Treasury product, to support valuation in potential lending, collateral and treasury workflows.
